uzo.purpose: Fills an area while its content loads, or when there is none: loading standards, no standards yet.

instead.kialo: An action that is working is the butono's own loading, because the person waits at the button they pressed; an area loads when its content is not there yet.
Progress of a task in percent is neither a measure like the mezurilo's nor a wait, because it moves by itself; that is an Ero of its own, a person decides.

boundary.kialo: A grey shape of the content to come promises a layout the data may not have, because it is drawn before the data; the text says what loads.

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: A table without rows shows its empty state in place of the rows, because the person looks there for them (tabelo, ④).

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section whose content loads or is empty fills itself with the state, because an empty section says nothing.

with.kialo: An empty state may offer the next step, because 'none yet' asks what to do; a working action is the butono's own loading.
